nodes.description: Owner/privileged address stored in DSAuth, AdminAuth and Migrations.
DSAuthority (DSGuard) reference controlling proxy permissions.
Admin multisig address in AdminAuth that can change owner.
Authorized monitor contract allowed to call execute on user proxies.
Timestamp recording start of monitor change process.
DSProxyCache mapping of code hash to deployed target address.
Auth mapping/allowed flag gating DFSProxy callProxy.
Monitor proxy mapping of allowed operators.
DFSProxy per-user nonce replay protection mapping.
Gas price cap used when refunding gas cost to bots.
msg.sender external caller input.
tx.origin used for bot detection and 0x fee refunds.
block.timestamp (now) used in monitor change timing checks.
Auth-gated function updating the owner state variable.
Auth-gated function updating the authority state variable.
Authorization check reading owner/authority and calling authority.canCall.
Deploys arbitrary code via assembly create and stores it in cache.
Computes DFS fee, uses tx.origin for bot fee tier and transfers to wallet.
Transfers a specified token/ETH amount to a user address.
Computes maximum withdrawable collateral from Aave using arithmetic.
Repays Aave debt: redeems aToken, swaps via external wrappers and repays.
Boosts Aave position: borrows, swaps via external wrappers and deposits.
Only monitor may call execute on a user DSProxy and receive leftover ETH.
Creates DSGuard authority if absent and permits an address to execute.
Forbids an address from executing on the proxy through the guard.
Owner-gated first-time admin assignment.
Admin-gated owner transfer of the contract.
Only owner may selfdestruct the contract.
Owner-gated toggling of authorized addresses.
Owner-gated global authorization flag toggle.
Signature authorized proxy execution with nonce and ecrecover check.
Owner-gated custom service fee assignment.
Performs 0x/buy/sell orders via low-level call to allowlisted addresses.
Transfers tokens to an arbitrary registered wrapper and calls sell/buy.
Draws DAI from a Maker CDP, applying max-debt arithmetic.
Repays Maker CDP debt via daiJoin and frob.
Aave flash loan callback executing arbitrary receiver logic and repaying.
Triggers flash loan to move a Compound position to a user DSProxy.
Allowed users start monitor change and record current time.
Confirms pending monitor change after CHANGE_PERIOD using now.
Low-level call to token contract validating optional boolean return.
selfdestruct(payable(owner)) destroys contract and sends funds.
Arbitrary target.call(data) e.g. 0x order execution and token calls.
Inline assembly create deploying user supplied bytecode.
Signature recovery authorizing proxy calls without replay protection beyond nonces.
ETH transfer/call{value} to caller or user controlled address.
Integer arithmetic (mul/div/add/sub) with protocol-defined rounding and overflow assumptions.
New owner address passed to DSAuth.setOwner.
New authority address passed to DSAuth.setAuthority.
Admin address passed to setAdminByOwner.
New owner address passed to setOwnerByAdmin.
Monitor address passed to setMonitor/changeMonitor.
Pending monitor address passed to changeMonitor.
User address used for fee tier and refund calculations.
Amount used in fee and gas cost calculations.
Estimated gas cost refund amount supplied to proxy actions.
Token address used when computing fee amounts.
Local variable holding current proxy authority in ProxyPermission.
Local variable holding contract ETH balance before withdrawal.

edges.reason: auth modifier gates setOwner through isAuthorized(msg.sender, msg.sig).
msg.sender is passed as src into isAuthorized authorization check.
require(msg.sender == admin) gates owner change.
onlyOwner modifier verifies msg.sender before toggling authorized.
onlyOwner modifier verifies msg.sender before setting global authorization.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates service fee assignment.
caller is bound to _user through ecrecover check in callProxy.
onlyMonitor modifier requires msg.sender == monitor before executing proxy call.
tx.origin selects automatic vs manual fee tier, creating origin dependency.
tx.origin receives 0x fee refunds inside Aave repay.
tx.origin returned leftover ETH in importLoan flow.
now is written into changeRequestedTimestamp starting the change window.
now is compared against changeRequestedTimestamp + CHANGE_PERIOD.
isAuthorized reads owner to decide authorization.
isAuthorized reads authority and delegates to canCall.
setOwner overwrites privileged owner state variable.
setAuthority overwrites authority controlling proxy permissions.
write passes user supplied _code into assembly create for deployment.
fee division and gas cost addition can overflow/round unexpectedly.
max collateral formula uses mul/sub/div/wmul that can overflow.
repay caps swap amount using getMaxCollateral computation.
_sell invokes saverSwap performing external calls to exchange wrappers.
boost routes swappable amount through saverSwap.
leftover ETH balance is transferred to msg.sender after external execute call.
givePermission creates/sets DSGuard authority on the proxy.
removePermission forbids execution via the current DSGuard authority.
setAdminByOwner assigns admin privileged state variable.
setOwnerByAdmin transfers owner privilege.
kill invokes selfdestruct to owner address.
setAuthorized writes the authorization mapping gating callProxy.
setAllAuthorized flips global authorization bypassing per-user checks.
ecrecover digest authorizes arbitrary proxy execution.
nonces mapping prevents replay of signed proxy calls.
owner requirement protects fee configuration.
takeOrder performs arbitrary call with value to allowlisted exchange addresses.
saverSwap calls external wrapper sell/buy which can re-enter.
drawDai and paybackDebt operate together on Maker CDP debt.
normalizePaybackAmount arithmetic computes dart for frob.
token transfers performed through low-level call to token address.
flash loan provider callback re-enters receiver logic during external call.
sendContractBalance transfers ETH via payable transfer.
getFee transfers computed fee to the wallet address.
importLoan gives flash loan permission on the proxy before external call.

normalization_plan.reason: owner_ is the direct argument assigned to the owner state variable by setOwner.
authority_ is the direct argument assigned to the authority state variable by setAuthority.
_admin is the sole argument assigned into the admin state variable.
_owner is the sole argument written into the owner state variable.
_monitor value flows directly into the newMonitor/monitor assignment of the change flow.
_newMonitor is stored as the pending monitor target.
_user selects the custom fee and drives the fee amount computation.
_amount is the base value divided by the fee rate.
_gasCost is forwarded into fee computation inside repay.
_tokenAddr determines which asset is transferred for the fee.
currAuthority is read only to decide whether a new DSGuard authority is created.
balance is read immediately before the payable transfer of contract funds.
